tacticalRoster.proxyCautions: These are engine proxies. No generic religious race, no monks representing forced belief. Enemy units are military/raider gameplay groups, not every neighbouring civilian.

entityRepresentation.record: named noncombat carrier with physical copy object/token, no magical relic bonus
entityRepresentation.wagon: Trade Cart visual proxy with trading disabled; fixed consignments and no renewable trade gold
entityRepresentation.family: named villager groups, no farming/economic AI when representing escorted parties
entityRepresentation.military-post: Watch Tower base DE proxy; two objectives have stable unit IDs, unrelated civilians excluded
entityRepresentation.water: named noncombat consignment, amount of water is narrative inventory, not an undocumented fifth engine resource
entityRepresentation.commander: named fictional Militia proxy, essential only when objective explicitly requires commander; no sacred unit
entityRepresentation.recovery: four preplaced guards released once with protected resources, persisting after save/load

economicAnalysis.classification: feasibility envelope, not a combat simulation or proof of balance
economicAnalysis.walkingAndIdleIncluded: Assumed rate discounts native gathering for travel/idle; measure actual efficiency in game.
economicAnalysis.sensitivity: At 50% of assumed efficiency recompute delivery window; do not spawn hidden resources. Split workers 50%food/25%wood/20%gold/5%stone, change allocation when a specified delivery requires stone.
economicAnalysis.travelTime: Measure nav-path length in tiles / actual convoy speed plus loading/unloading; two round trips must fit between phase waves. If not, adjust announced gap or move receiving point within same documented district; architect approval for footprint drift.

scenarios.historicalFrame: Qadisiyya enfrenta fuerzas árabes y sasánidas; fecha y sitio precisos son discutidos. Se conserva resultado general sin inventar orden de batalla seguro.

personalNarration.en: The channels were new to me. I asked the people who worked them where a cart could cross; a soldier’s sketch alone would have drowned the load.
personalNarration.es-ES: Los canales eran nuevos para mí. Pregunté dónde podía cruzar un carro a quienes los trabajaban; un dibujo militar habría hundido la carga.

scenarios.historicalOutcome: Cambios políticos tras victoria; no presentar conversiones iraníes como instantáneas ni batalla étnica eterna.
scenarios.choice: Escoger ruta principal o alternativa: el hecho histórico y objetivos principales permanecen.
scenarios.recovery: Canal estrecho con dos pasos de 10+casillas. Elefantes solo si se justifican por fuente y catálogo; retirada por diagonal seca siempre abierta.

historicalBrief.en: The battle conventionally dated to 636 or 637 at Qadisiyya contributed to the loss of Sasanian control in Iraq. Its date and battlefield details are debated.

qa.expected: All narrator facts link to claim/source; uncertainty spoken when essential; fictional dialogue labelled.
Landmark banks and coast orientation match regional controls; no anachronisms listed in profile.
Flood fill with unit footprint, bridge/naval checks; land routes cannot jump water; largest convoy reaches all goals.
Targets destroyed/archives saved before activation latch and unlock later objectives.
Save before/after every delivery and wave; reload cannot duplicate or lose counts.
Roster initial plus three waves <= cap in each difficulty; all enemy production off.
Lose one courier/boat or two families; documented fallback exists without repeating payments.
Normal success rates 60–80% familiar AoE2 cohort, easy 80–95% learning cohort, hard 35–60% expert blind cohort: hypotheses, not measurements.
General factual brief then campaign person; no omniscience or lived memory before birth.
All screens EN and es-ES, 17 full destination catalogs reviewed for release; no implicit engine fallback.
Recorded 20min crowded replay below frame/simulation degradation budget.
Fresh/profile one-route/both/unknown/replay preserve cumulative keys and nonblocking static recommendation.

tacticalRoster.proxyCautions: These are engine proxies. No generic religious race, no monks representing forced belief. Enemy units are military/raider gameplay groups, not every neighbouring civilian.

entityRepresentation.record: named noncombat carrier with physical copy object/token, no magical relic bonus
entityRepresentation.wagon: Trade Cart visual proxy with trading disabled; fixed consignments and no renewable trade gold
entityRepresentation.family: named villager groups, no farming/economic AI when representing escorted parties
entityRepresentation.military-post: Watch Tower base DE proxy; two objectives have stable unit IDs, unrelated civilians excluded
entityRepresentation.water: named noncombat consignment, amount of water is narrative inventory, not an undocumented fifth engine resource
entityRepresentation.commander: named fictional Militia proxy, essential only when objective explicitly requires commander; no sacred unit

economicAnalysis.classification: feasibility envelope, not a combat simulation or proof of balance
economicAnalysis.walkingAndIdleIncluded: Assumed rate discounts native gathering for travel/idle; measure actual efficiency in game.
economicAnalysis.sensitivity: At 50% of assumed efficiency recompute delivery window; do not spawn hidden resources. Split workers 50%food/25%wood/20%gold/5%stone, change allocation when a specified delivery requires stone.
economicAnalysis.travelTime: Measure nav-path length in tiles / actual convoy speed plus loading/unloading; two round trips must fit between phase waves. If not, adjust announced gap or move receiving point within same documented district; architect approval for footprint drift.

personalNarration.en: The Nile made my old measure of a well seem foolish. Yet every cargo still needed a name, a receipt, and someone willing to answer for it.

scenarios.historicalOutcome: Epílogo distingue 642 de 656; I01 continúa crisis política, no descarga obligatoria.
scenarios.choice: Escoger ruta principal o alternativa: el hecho histórico y objetivos principales permanecen.
scenarios.recovery: Transporte perdido: una barcaza de reserva y camino terrestre de mayores coste/tiempo. Acuerdo fijo una vez, no tributo infinito.

failureRecovery.notDefeat: Historical fall, sack, defeat or death of an off-map documented figure is narrative context. Player defeat is failing this mission’s rescue/supply/tactical task.
failureRecovery.deadlockDetection: No objective progress for 6 game minutes shows the exact outstanding goal and route, with optional recovery reminder. No automatic victory.
failureRecovery.abuse: Killing civilian neighbours gives no gold/score. Essential historical figures are off-map narrative subjects, never convertable units.

qa.expected: All narrator facts link to claim/source; uncertainty spoken when essential; fictional dialogue labelled.
Landmark banks and coast orientation match regional controls; no anachronisms listed in profile.
Flood fill with unit footprint, bridge/naval checks; land routes cannot jump water; largest convoy reaches all goals.
Targets destroyed/archives saved before activation latch and unlock later objectives.
Save before/after every delivery and wave; reload cannot duplicate or lose counts.
Roster initial plus three waves <= cap in each difficulty; all enemy production off.
Lose one courier/boat or two families; documented fallback exists without repeating payments.
Normal success rates 60–80% familiar AoE2 cohort, easy 80–95% learning cohort, hard 35–60% expert blind cohort: hypotheses, not measurements.
General factual brief then campaign person; no omniscience or lived memory before birth.
All screens EN and es-ES, 17 full destination catalogs reviewed for release; no implicit engine fallback.
Recorded 20min crowded replay below frame/simulation degradation budget.
Fresh/profile one-route/both/unknown/replay preserve cumulative keys and nonblocking static recommendation.

player.carriers: one noncombat carrier per task entity, all named fictional

tacticalRoster.proxyCautions: These are engine proxies. No generic religious race, no monks representing forced belief. Enemy units are military/raider gameplay groups, not every neighbouring civilian.

entityRepresentation.record: named noncombat carrier with physical copy object/token, no magical relic bonus
entityRepresentation.wagon: Trade Cart visual proxy with trading disabled; fixed consignments and no renewable trade gold
entityRepresentation.family: named villager groups, no farming/economic AI when representing escorted parties
entityRepresentation.military-post: Watch Tower base DE proxy; two objectives have stable unit IDs, unrelated civilians excluded
entityRepresentation.water: named noncombat consignment, amount of water is narrative inventory, not an undocumented fifth engine resource
entityRepresentation.commander: named fictional Militia proxy, essential only when objective explicitly requires commander; no sacred unit
entityRepresentation.recovery: four preplaced guards released once with protected resources, persisting after save/load

economicAnalysis.classification: feasibility envelope, not a combat simulation or proof of balance
economicAnalysis.walkingAndIdleIncluded: Assumed rate discounts native gathering for travel/idle; measure actual efficiency in game.
economicAnalysis.sensitivity: At 50% of assumed efficiency recompute delivery window; do not spawn hidden resources. Split workers 50%food/25%wood/20%gold/5%stone, change allocation when a specified delivery requires stone.
economicAnalysis.travelTime: Measure nav-path length in tiles / actual convoy speed plus loading/unloading; two round trips must fit between phase waves. If not, adjust announced gap or move receiving point within same documented district; architect approval for footprint drift.

campaigns.chronologyPolicy: Recommended order is narrative, not always chronological: the successor may overlap or revisit earlier events; announce its own date.

representation.rationale: Engine proxy for available period-neutral gameplay, never identity of a religion or claim of authentic material culture. Resolve numeric IDs from the pinned parser catalogue.
representation.dlc: Base DE proxies only; do not require Romans/RoR/DLC or silently use a different game mode.
representation.technology: Feudal maximum by default; no gunpowder, modern fortifications, monks converting faith, unique units, trebuchets or late plate-armoured knights. Battering ram is an explicit visual/technology proxy where military outposts must fall.

artDirection.medium: Painted historical illustration, map first; contemporary reference photos are for research only.
artDirection.cover: Beneath the Desert Stars: Yathrib / Medina oasis, 622 CE; foreground Administrador de caravanas y suministros; no modern skyline or invented sacred portrait.
artDirection.portrait: Fictional Salim, the Caravan Scribe, occupational props, plain clothing without fabricated uniform; expression follows temperament. Label composite fictional narrator in credits.
artDirection.delivery: One cover, one narrator portrait, one context map per scenario; licensed or original PNG; no paid batch authorized.

text.en: Beneath the Desert Stars
text.es-ES: Bajo las estrellas del desierto

text.en: 622–656 CE. Follow Salim, the Caravan Scribe through 5 scenarios. Each begins with a factual account, then a personal recollection. All campaigns can be played independently.
text.es-ES: 622–656 CE. Sigue a Salim, the Caravan Scribe en 5 escenarios. Cada uno comienza con un relato de los hechos y después una memoria personal. Todas las campañas se pueden jugar de forma independiente.

text.en: The shared narrator gives the historical frame. The campaign narrator is a fictional person whose memories, songs and inherited accounts offer a situated perspective. Invented dialogue is never a historical quotation.
text.es-ES: El narrador común presenta el marco histórico. El narrador de campaña es un personaje ficticio cuya memoria, cantares y relatos heredados ofrecen una perspectiva situada. Los diálogos inventados nunca son citas históricas.

text.en: I knew the sky by its stars and a road by its wells. Then the roads began to lead farther than any ledger I had carried.
text.es-ES: Conocía el cielo por sus estrellas y el camino por sus pozos. Después los caminos llegaron más lejos que cualquier registro que había llevado.

text.en: You may begin here. Dates on each scenario distinguish events from later memories. No earlier campaign is required.
text.es-ES: Puedes empezar aquí. Las fechas de cada escenario distinguen los hechos de las memorias posteriores. No necesitas una campaña anterior.

text.en: This campaign is complete. Your completed perspective is remembered. Recommended next: The Shattered Oath (CDF-I01; begins 656 CE). You can also replay another perspective; previous choices remain recorded.
text.es-ES: Esta campaña ha terminado. Se recuerda tu perspectiva completed. Continúa con El juramento quebrado (CDF-I01; comienza en 656 CE). También puedes rejugar otra perspectiva; se conservan las elecciones anteriores.

campaigns.theme: Guerra civil y autoridad en disputa; las tradiciones posteriores no son dos bloques ya acabados en 656.

narrator.name: Farid, the Field Medic
narrator.occupation: Auxiliar de enfermería militar y escriba de listas de bajas
narrator.temperament: Contenido, desconfiado de consignas, atento a detalles materiales; simpatías explícitas, ninguna omnisciencia moral.
narrator.backstory: Trabajó con redes de auxilio iraquíes; conoce distintos campamentos por traslados ficticios y relatos. No es consejero documentado de Ali o Muawiya.

failureRecovery.notDefeat: Historical fall, sack, defeat or death of an off-map documented figure is narrative context. Player defeat is failing this mission’s rescue/supply/tactical task.

qa.expected: All narrator facts link to claim/source; uncertainty spoken when essential; fictional dialogue labelled.
Landmark banks and coast orientation match regional controls; no anachronisms listed in profile.
Flood fill with unit footprint, bridge/naval checks; land routes cannot jump water; largest convoy reaches all goals.
Targets destroyed/archives saved before activation latch and unlock later objectives.
Save before/after every delivery and wave; reload cannot duplicate or lose counts.
Roster initial plus three waves <= cap in each difficulty; all enemy production off.
Lose one courier/boat or two families; documented fallback exists without repeating payments.
Normal success rates 60–80% familiar AoE2 cohort, easy 80–95% learning cohort, hard 35–60% expert blind cohort: hypotheses, not measurements.
General factual brief then campaign person; no omniscience or lived memory before birth.
All screens EN and es-ES, 17 full destination catalogs reviewed for release; no implicit engine fallback.
Recorded 20min crowded replay below frame/simulation degradation budget.
Fresh/profile one-route/both/unknown/replay preserve cumulative keys and nonblocking static recommendation.

tacticalRoster.proxyCautions: These are engine proxies. No generic religious race, no monks representing forced belief. Enemy units are military/raider gameplay groups, not every neighbouring civilian.

entityRepresentation.record: named noncombat carrier with physical copy object/token, no magical relic bonus
entityRepresentation.wagon: Trade Cart visual proxy with trading disabled; fixed consignments and no renewable trade gold
entityRepresentation.family: named villager groups, no farming/economic AI when representing escorted parties
entityRepresentation.military-post: Watch Tower base DE proxy; two objectives have stable unit IDs, unrelated civilians excluded
entityRepresentation.water: named noncombat consignment, amount of water is narrative inventory, not an undocumented fifth engine resource
entityRepresentation.commander: named fictional Militia proxy, essential only when objective explicitly requires commander; no sacred unit
entityRepresentation.recovery: four preplaced guards released once with protected resources, persisting after save/load

economicAnalysis.classification: feasibility envelope, not a combat simulation or proof of balance
economicAnalysis.walkingAndIdleIncluded: Assumed rate discounts native gathering for travel/idle; measure actual efficiency in game.
economicAnalysis.sensitivity: At 50% of assumed efficiency recompute delivery window; do not spawn hidden resources. Split workers 50%food/25%wood/20%gold/5%stone, change allocation when a specified delivery requires stone.
economicAnalysis.travelTime: Measure nav-path length in tiles / actual convoy speed plus loading/unloading; two round trips must fit between phase waves. If not, adjust announced gap or move receiving point within same documented district; architect approval for footprint drift.

personalNarration.en: Neither side called its own dead a mistake. I had no room for either banner on the wagon; the bandages filled it.

scenarios.choice: Escoger ruta principal o alternativa: el hecho histórico y objetivos principales permanecen.
scenarios.recovery: Ruta seca oeste y ruta de diques al este. Civiles rescatados no vuelven a contarse; retirar a tiempo permite completar tras pérdida de un carro.

tacticalRoster.proxyCautions: These are engine proxies. No generic religious race, no monks representing forced belief. Enemy units are military/raider gameplay groups, not every neighbouring civilian.

entityRepresentation.record: named noncombat carrier with physical copy object/token, no magical relic bonus

entityRepresentation.water: named noncombat consignment, amount of water is narrative inventory, not an undocumented fifth engine resource

economicAnalysis.classification: feasibility envelope, not a combat simulation or proof of balance
economicAnalysis.walkingAndIdleIncluded: Assumed rate discounts native gathering for travel/idle; measure actual efficiency in game.
economicAnalysis.sensitivity: At 50% of assumed efficiency recompute delivery window; do not spawn hidden resources. Split workers 50%food/25%wood/20%gold/5%stone, change allocation when a specified delivery requires stone.
economicAnalysis.travelTime: Measure nav-path length in tiles / actual convoy speed plus loading/unloading; two round trips must fit between phase waves. If not, adjust announced gap or move receiving point within same documented district; architect approval for footprint drift.

scenarios.historicalFrame: Siffin y negociación/arbitraje están documentados con relatos divergentes. Condiciones de tregua y acceso al agua son reconstrucción jugable.

player.carriers: one noncombat carrier per task entity, all named fictional

tacticalRoster.proxyCautions: These are engine proxies. No generic religious race, no monks representing forced belief. Enemy units are military/raider gameplay groups, not every neighbouring civilian.

entityRepresentation.record: named noncombat carrier with physical copy object/token, no magical relic bonus
entityRepresentation.wagon: Trade Cart visual proxy with trading disabled; fixed consignments and no renewable trade gold
entityRepresentation.family: named villager groups, no farming/economic AI when representing escorted parties
entityRepresentation.military-post: Watch Tower base DE proxy; two objectives have stable unit IDs, unrelated civilians excluded
entityRepresentation.water: named noncombat consignment, amount of water is narrative inventory, not an undocumented fifth engine resource
entityRepresentation.commander: named fictional Militia proxy, essential only when objective explicitly requires commander; no sacred unit
entityRepresentation.recovery: four preplaced guards released once with protected resources, persisting after save/load

economicAnalysis.classification: feasibility envelope, not a combat simulation or proof of balance
economicAnalysis.walkingAndIdleIncluded: Assumed rate discounts native gathering for travel/idle; measure actual efficiency in game.
economicAnalysis.sensitivity: At 50% of assumed efficiency recompute delivery window; do not spawn hidden resources. Split workers 50%food/25%wood/20%gold/5%stone, change allocation when a specified delivery requires stone.
economicAnalysis.travelTime: Measure nav-path length in tiles / actual convoy speed plus loading/unloading; two round trips must fit between phase waves. If not, adjust announced gap or move receiving point within same documented district; architect approval for footprint drift.

failureRecovery.plan: Dos cruces, carro crítico no se queda en canal por edificio construido. Un relevo finito en retaguardia; no orden irreversible hasta paso del convoy.
failureRecovery.budget: One reserve escort only, drawn from protected stock and accounted starting reserve; no infinite recruit loop.
failureRecovery.notDefeat: Historical fall, sack, defeat or death of an off-map documented figure is narrative context. Player defeat is failing this mission’s rescue/supply/tactical task.
failureRecovery.deadlockDetection: No objective progress for 6 game minutes shows the exact outstanding goal and route, with optional recovery reminder. No automatic victory.
failureRecovery.abuse: Killing civilian neighbours gives no gold/score. Essential historical figures are off-map narrative subjects, never convertable units.

qa.expected: All narrator facts link to claim/source; uncertainty spoken when essential; fictional dialogue labelled.
Landmark banks and coast orientation match regional controls; no anachronisms listed in profile.
Flood fill with unit footprint, bridge/naval checks; land routes cannot jump water; largest convoy reaches all goals.
Targets destroyed/archives saved before activation latch and unlock later objectives.
Save before/after every delivery and wave; reload cannot duplicate or lose counts.
Roster initial plus three waves <= cap in each difficulty; all enemy production off.
Lose one courier/boat or two families; documented fallback exists without repeating payments.
Normal success rates 60–80% familiar AoE2 cohort, easy 80–95% learning cohort, hard 35–60% expert blind cohort: hypotheses, not measurements.
General factual brief then campaign person; no omniscience or lived memory before birth.
All screens EN and es-ES, 17 full destination catalogs reviewed for release; no implicit engine fallback.
Recorded 20min crowded replay below frame/simulation degradation budget.
Fresh/profile one-route/both/unknown/replay preserve cumulative keys and nonblocking static recommendation.

player.carriers: one noncombat carrier per task entity, all named fictional

tacticalRoster.proxyCautions: These are engine proxies. No generic religious race, no monks representing forced belief. Enemy units are military/raider gameplay groups, not every neighbouring civilian.

entityRepresentation.record: named noncombat carrier with physical copy object/token, no magical relic bonus
entityRepresentation.wagon: Trade Cart visual proxy with trading disabled; fixed consignments and no renewable trade gold
entityRepresentation.family: named villager groups, no farming/economic AI when representing escorted parties
entityRepresentation.military-post: Watch Tower base DE proxy; two objectives have stable unit IDs, unrelated civilians excluded
entityRepresentation.water: named noncombat consignment, amount of water is narrative inventory, not an undocumented fifth engine resource
entityRepresentation.commander: named fictional Militia proxy, essential only when objective explicitly requires commander; no sacred unit
entityRepresentation.recovery: four preplaced guards released once with protected resources, persisting after save/load

economicAnalysis.classification: feasibility envelope, not a combat simulation or proof of balance
economicAnalysis.walkingAndIdleIncluded: Assumed rate discounts native gathering for travel/idle; measure actual efficiency in game.
economicAnalysis.sensitivity: At 50% of assumed efficiency recompute delivery window; do not spawn hidden resources. Split workers 50%food/25%wood/20%gold/5%stone, change allocation when a specified delivery requires stone.
economicAnalysis.travelTime: Measure nav-path length in tiles / actual convoy speed plus loading/unloading; two round trips must fit between phase waves. If not, adjust announced gap or move receiving point within same documented district; architect approval for footprint drift.

failureRecovery.budget: One reserve escort only, drawn from protected stock and accounted starting reserve; no infinite recruit loop.
failureRecovery.notDefeat: Historical fall, sack, defeat or death of an off-map documented figure is narrative context. Player defeat is failing this mission’s rescue/supply/tactical task.

qa.expected: All narrator facts link to claim/source; uncertainty spoken when essential; fictional dialogue labelled.
Landmark banks and coast orientation match regional controls; no anachronisms listed in profile.
Flood fill with unit footprint, bridge/naval checks; land routes cannot jump water; largest convoy reaches all goals.
Targets destroyed/archives saved before activation latch and unlock later objectives.
Save before/after every delivery and wave; reload cannot duplicate or lose counts.
Roster initial plus three waves <= cap in each difficulty; all enemy production off.
Lose one courier/boat or two families; documented fallback exists without repeating payments.
Normal success rates 60–80% familiar AoE2 cohort, easy 80–95% learning cohort, hard 35–60% expert blind cohort: hypotheses, not measurements.
General factual brief then campaign person; no omniscience or lived memory before birth.
All screens EN and es-ES, 17 full destination catalogs reviewed for release; no implicit engine fallback.
Recorded 20min crowded replay below frame/simulation degradation budget.
Fresh/profile one-route/both/unknown/replay preserve cumulative keys and nonblocking static recommendation.

tacticalRoster.proxyCautions: These are engine proxies. No generic religious race, no monks representing forced belief. Enemy units are military/raider gameplay groups, not every neighbouring civilian.

entityRepresentation.record: named noncombat carrier with physical copy object/token, no magical relic bonus
entityRepresentation.wagon: Trade Cart visual proxy with trading disabled; fixed consignments and no renewable trade gold
entityRepresentation.family: named villager groups, no farming/economic AI when representing escorted parties
entityRepresentation.military-post: Watch Tower base DE proxy; two objectives have stable unit IDs, unrelated civilians excluded
entityRepresentation.water: named noncombat consignment, amount of water is narrative inventory, not an undocumented fifth engine resource
entityRepresentation.commander: named fictional Militia proxy, essential only when objective explicitly requires commander; no sacred unit

economicAnalysis.classification: feasibility envelope, not a combat simulation or proof of balance
economicAnalysis.walkingAndIdleIncluded: Assumed rate discounts native gathering for travel/idle; measure actual efficiency in game.
economicAnalysis.sensitivity: At 50% of assumed efficiency recompute delivery window; do not spawn hidden resources. Split workers 50%food/25%wood/20%gold/5%stone, change allocation when a specified delivery requires stone.
economicAnalysis.travelTime: Measure nav-path length in tiles / actual convoy speed plus loading/unloading; two round trips must fit between phase waves. If not, adjust announced gap or move receiving point within same documented district; architect approval for footprint drift.

campaigns.chronologyPolicy: Recommended order is narrative, not always chronological: the successor may overlap or revisit earlier events; announce its own date.

representation.rationale: Engine proxy for available period-neutral gameplay, never identity of a religion or claim of authentic material culture. Resolve numeric IDs from the pinned parser catalogue.
representation.dlc: Base DE proxies only; do not require Romans/RoR/DLC or silently use a different game mode.
representation.technology: Feudal maximum by default; no gunpowder, modern fortifications, monks converting faith, unique units, trebuchets or late plate-armoured knights. Battering ram is an explicit visual/technology proxy where military outposts must fall.

text.en: 656–661 CE. Follow Farid, the Field Medic through 5 scenarios. Each begins with a factual account, then a personal recollection. All campaigns can be played independently.

title.en: From Damascus to the Far Horizon

campaigns.theme: Administración, obras y expansión de un imperio diverso; el final omeya de 750 no acaba su linaje ni inaugura homogeneidad social.

narrator.name: Yasir, the Cloth Merchant
narrator.occupation: Mercader de tejidos y portador de cuentas entre talleres
narrator.temperament: Ambicioso, curioso y buen negociador; aprende a reconocer los costes escondidos de un triunfo.
narrator.backstory: Su madre trabajó con redes de talleres levantinos; creció entre rutas de Damasco. Describe 661/691/698 por cuentas familiares y 711 por relatos de infancia, no como general presente.

opening.en: My first map was a list of debts. The empire looked boundless until I learned how far a promise could travel before it broke.

player.carriers: one noncombat carrier per task entity, all named fictional

tacticalRoster.proxyCautions: These are engine proxies. No generic religious race, no monks representing forced belief. Enemy units are military/raider gameplay groups, not every neighbouring civilian.

entityRepresentation.record: named noncombat carrier with physical copy object/token, no magical relic bonus
entityRepresentation.wagon: Trade Cart visual proxy with trading disabled; fixed consignments and no renewable trade gold
entityRepresentation.family: named villager groups, no farming/economic AI when representing escorted parties
entityRepresentation.military-post: Watch Tower base DE proxy; two objectives have stable unit IDs, unrelated civilians excluded
entityRepresentation.water: named noncombat consignment, amount of water is narrative inventory, not an undocumented fifth engine resource
entityRepresentation.commander: named fictional Militia proxy, essential only when objective explicitly requires commander; no sacred unit
entityRepresentation.recovery: four preplaced guards released once with protected resources, persisting after save/load

economicAnalysis.classification: feasibility envelope, not a combat simulation or proof of balance
economicAnalysis.walkingAndIdleIncluded: Assumed rate discounts native gathering for travel/idle; measure actual efficiency in game.
economicAnalysis.sensitivity: At 50% of assumed efficiency recompute delivery window; do not spawn hidden resources. Split workers 50%food/25%wood/20%gold/5%stone, change allocation when a specified delivery requires stone.
economicAnalysis.travelTime: Measure nav-path length in tiles / actual convoy speed plus loading/unloading; two round trips must fit between phase waves. If not, adjust announced gap or move receiving point within same documented district; architect approval for footprint drift.

scenarios.historicalFrame: Construcción de la Cúpula de la Roca bajo Abd al-Malik. Fecha691/692 y acabado original se distinguen de restauraciones posteriores.

personalNarration.en: A ledger can price stone. It cannot price what a place means to every person who looks at it. My mother left that column blank.

scenarios.historicalOutcome: Monumento y significado se narran sin decidir legitimidad contemporánea de comunidades.
scenarios.choice: Escoger ruta principal o alternativa: el hecho histórico y objetivos principales permanecen.
scenarios.recovery: Puertas de obras oeste/sur; al perder un envío existe reserva suficiente en segundo almacén. No usar oro como marcador de fe.

player.carriers: one noncombat carrier per task entity, all named fictional

tacticalRoster.proxyCautions: These are engine proxies. No generic religious race, no monks representing forced belief. Enemy units are military/raider gameplay groups, not every neighbouring civilian.

entityRepresentation.record: named noncombat carrier with physical copy object/token, no magical relic bonus
entityRepresentation.wagon: Trade Cart visual proxy with trading disabled; fixed consignments and no renewable trade gold
entityRepresentation.family: named villager groups, no farming/economic AI when representing escorted parties
entityRepresentation.military-post: Watch Tower base DE proxy; two objectives have stable unit IDs, unrelated civilians excluded
entityRepresentation.water: named noncombat consignment, amount of water is narrative inventory, not an undocumented fifth engine resource
entityRepresentation.commander: named fictional Militia proxy, essential only when objective explicitly requires commander; no sacred unit
entityRepresentation.recovery: four preplaced guards released once with protected resources, persisting after save/load

economicAnalysis.classification: feasibility envelope, not a combat simulation or proof of balance
economicAnalysis.walkingAndIdleIncluded: Assumed rate discounts native gathering for travel/idle; measure actual efficiency in game.
economicAnalysis.sensitivity: At 50% of assumed efficiency recompute delivery window; do not spawn hidden resources. Split workers 50%food/25%wood/20%gold/5%stone, change allocation when a specified delivery requires stone.
economicAnalysis.travelTime: Measure nav-path length in tiles / actual convoy speed plus loading/unloading; two round trips must fit between phase waves. If not, adjust announced gap or move receiving point within same documented district; architect approval for footprint drift.

scenarios.historicalFrame: Cambio de poder en Cartago dentro de expansión norteafricana; el convoy y táctica costera son reconstrucción. Fecha y secuencia regional requieren fuente específica del dossier.

failureRecovery.budget: One reserve escort only, drawn from protected stock and accounted starting reserve; no infinite recruit loop.
failureRecovery.notDefeat: Historical fall, sack, defeat or death of an off-map documented figure is narrative context. Player defeat is failing this mission’s rescue/supply/tactical task.
failureRecovery.deadlockDetection: No objective progress for 6 game minutes shows the exact outstanding goal and route, with optional recovery reminder. No automatic victory.
failureRecovery.abuse: Killing civilian neighbours gives no gold/score. Essential historical figures are off-map narrative subjects, never convertable units.

qa.expected: All narrator facts link to claim/source; uncertainty spoken when essential; fictional dialogue labelled.
Landmark banks and coast orientation match regional controls; no anachronisms listed in profile.
Flood fill with unit footprint, bridge/naval checks; land routes cannot jump water; largest convoy reaches all goals.
Targets destroyed/archives saved before activation latch and unlock later objectives.
Save before/after every delivery and wave; reload cannot duplicate or lose counts.
Roster initial plus three waves <= cap in each difficulty; all enemy production off.
Lose one courier/boat or two families; documented fallback exists without repeating payments.
Normal success rates 60–80% familiar AoE2 cohort, easy 80–95% learning cohort, hard 35–60% expert blind cohort: hypotheses, not measurements.
General factual brief then campaign person; no omniscience or lived memory before birth.
All screens EN and es-ES, 17 full destination catalogs reviewed for release; no implicit engine fallback.
Recorded 20min crowded replay below frame/simulation degradation budget.
Fresh/profile one-route/both/unknown/replay preserve cumulative keys and nonblocking static recommendation.

tacticalRoster.proxyCautions: These are engine proxies. No generic religious race, no monks representing forced belief. Enemy units are military/raider gameplay groups, not every neighbouring civilian.

entityRepresentation.record: named noncombat carrier with physical copy object/token, no magical relic bonus

entityRepresentation.water: named noncombat consignment, amount of water is narrative inventory, not an undocumented fifth engine resource

economicAnalysis.classification: feasibility envelope, not a combat simulation or proof of balance
economicAnalysis.walkingAndIdleIncluded: Assumed rate discounts native gathering for travel/idle; measure actual efficiency in game.
economicAnalysis.sensitivity: At 50% of assumed efficiency recompute delivery window; do not spawn hidden resources. Split workers 50%food/25%wood/20%gold/5%stone, change allocation when a specified delivery requires stone.
economicAnalysis.travelTime: Measure nav-path length in tiles / actual convoy speed plus loading/unloading; two round trips must fit between phase waves. If not, adjust announced gap or move receiving point within same documented district; architect approval for footprint drift.

qa.expected: All narrator facts link to claim/source; uncertainty spoken when essential; fictional dialogue labelled.

Roster initial plus three waves <= cap in each difficulty; all enemy production off.
Lose one courier/boat or two families; documented fallback exists without repeating payments.
Normal success rates 60–80% familiar AoE2 cohort, easy 80–95% learning cohort, hard 35–60% expert blind cohort: hypotheses, not measurements.
General factual brief then campaign person; no omniscience or lived memory before birth.
All screens EN and es-ES, 17 full destination catalogs reviewed for release; no implicit engine fallback.
Recorded 20min crowded replay below frame/simulation degradation budget.
Fresh/profile one-route/both/unknown/replay preserve cumulative keys and nonblocking static recommendation.

tacticalRoster.proxyCautions: These are engine proxies. No generic religious race, no monks representing forced belief. Enemy units are military/raider gameplay groups, not every neighbouring civilian.

entityRepresentation.record: named noncombat carrier with physical copy object/token, no magical relic bonus

entityRepresentation.water: named noncombat consignment, amount of water is narrative inventory, not an undocumented fifth engine resource

economicAnalysis.classification: feasibility envelope, not a combat simulation or proof of balance
economicAnalysis.walkingAndIdleIncluded: Assumed rate discounts native gathering for travel/idle; measure actual efficiency in game.
economicAnalysis.sensitivity: At 50% of assumed efficiency recompute delivery window; do not spawn hidden resources. Split workers 50%food/25%wood/20%gold/5%stone, change allocation when a specified delivery requires stone.
economicAnalysis.travelTime: Measure nav-path length in tiles / actual convoy speed plus loading/unloading; two round trips must fit between phase waves. If not, adjust announced gap or move receiving point within same documented district; architect approval for footprint drift.

failureRecovery.notDefeat: Historical fall, sack, defeat or death of an off-map documented figure is narrative context. Player defeat is failing this mission’s rescue/supply/tactical task.

qa.expected: All narrator facts link to claim/source; uncertainty spoken when essential; fictional dialogue labelled.

Save before/after every delivery and wave; reload cannot duplicate or lose counts.
Roster initial plus three waves <= cap in each difficulty; all enemy production off.
Lose one courier/boat or two families; documented fallback exists without repeating payments.
Normal success rates 60–80% familiar AoE2 cohort, easy 80–95% learning cohort, hard 35–60% expert blind cohort: hypotheses, not measurements.
General factual brief then campaign person; no omniscience or lived memory before birth.
All screens EN and es-ES, 17 full destination catalogs reviewed for release; no implicit engine fallback.
Recorded 20min crowded replay below frame/simulation degradation budget.
Fresh/profile one-route/both/unknown/replay preserve cumulative keys and nonblocking static recommendation.

entityRepresentation.record: named noncombat carrier with physical copy object/token, no magical relic bonus
entityRepresentation.wagon: Trade Cart visual proxy with trading disabled; fixed consignments and no renewable trade gold
entityRepresentation.family: named villager groups, no farming/economic AI when representing escorted parties
entityRepresentation.military-post: Watch Tower base DE proxy; two objectives have stable unit IDs, unrelated civilians excluded
entityRepresentation.water: named noncombat consignment, amount of water is narrative inventory, not an undocumented fifth engine resource

economicAnalysis.classification: feasibility envelope, not a combat simulation or proof of balance
economicAnalysis.walkingAndIdleIncluded: Assumed rate discounts native gathering for travel/idle; measure actual efficiency in game.
economicAnalysis.sensitivity: At 50% of assumed efficiency recompute delivery window; do not spawn hidden resources. Split workers 50%food/25%wood/20%gold/5%stone, change allocation when a specified delivery requires stone.
economicAnalysis.travelTime: Measure nav-path length in tiles / actual convoy speed plus loading/unloading; two round trips must fit between phase waves. If not, adjust announced gap or move receiving point within same documented district; architect approval for footprint drift.

campaigns.chronologyPolicy: Recommended order is narrative, not always chronological: the successor may overlap or revisit earlier events; announce its own date.

representation.rationale: Engine proxy for available period-neutral gameplay, never identity of a religion or claim of authentic material culture. Resolve numeric IDs from the pinned parser catalogue.
representation.dlc: Base DE proxies only; do not require Romans/RoR/DLC or silently use a different game mode.
representation.technology: Feudal maximum by default; no gunpowder, modern fortifications, monks converting faith, unique units, trebuchets or late plate-armoured knights. Battering ram is an explicit visual/technology proxy where military outposts must fall.

artDirection.medium: Painted historical illustration, map first; contemporary reference photos are for research only.
artDirection.cover: From Damascus to the Far Horizon: Damascus / Ghouta, 661 CE; foreground Mercader de tejidos y portador de cuentas entre talleres; no modern skyline or invented sacred portrait.
artDirection.portrait: Fictional Yasir, the Cloth Merchant, occupational props, plain clothing without fabricated uniform; expression follows temperament. Label composite fictional narrator in credits.
artDirection.delivery: One cover, one narrator portrait, one context map per scenario; licensed or original PNG; no paid batch authorized.

text.en: From Damascus to the Far Horizon

text.en: 661–750 CE. Follow Yasir, the Cloth Merchant through 5 scenarios. Each begins with a factual account, then a personal recollection. All campaigns can be played independently.

text.en: The shared narrator gives the historical frame. The campaign narrator is a fictional person whose memories, songs and inherited accounts offer a situated perspective. Invented dialogue is never a historical quotation.

text.en: My first map was a list of debts. The empire looked boundless until I learned how far a promise could travel before it broke.
text.es-ES: Mi primer mapa era una lista de deudas. El imperio parecía no tener límite hasta que aprendí cuán lejos podía viajar una promesa antes de romperse.

campaigns.theme: Red familiar y memoria de Ali, Hasan y Husayn; perspectivas y tradiciones comunitarias se atribuyen, nunca se representan como verdades ganadas con armas.

failureRecovery.notDefeat: Historical fall, sack, defeat or death of an off-map documented figure is narrative context. Player defeat is failing this mission’s rescue/supply/tactical task.
failureRecovery.deadlockDetection: No objective progress for 6 game minutes shows the exact outstanding goal and route, with optional recovery reminder. No automatic victory.
failureRecovery.abuse: Killing civilian neighbours gives no gold/score. Essential historical figures are off-map narrative subjects, never convertable units.

General factual brief then campaign person; no omniscience or lived memory before birth.

player.carriers: one noncombat carrier per task entity, all named fictional

tacticalRoster.proxyCautions: These are engine proxies. No generic religious race, no monks representing forced belief. Enemy units are military/raider gameplay groups, not every neighbouring civilian.

entityRepresentation.record: named noncombat carrier with physical copy object/token, no magical relic bonus
entityRepresentation.wagon: Trade Cart visual proxy with trading disabled; fixed consignments and no renewable trade gold
entityRepresentation.family: named villager groups, no farming/economic AI when representing escorted parties
entityRepresentation.military-post: Watch Tower base DE proxy; two objectives have stable unit IDs, unrelated civilians excluded
entityRepresentation.water: named noncombat consignment, amount of water is narrative inventory, not an undocumented fifth engine resource
entityRepresentation.commander: named fictional Militia proxy, essential only when objective explicitly requires commander; no sacred unit
entityRepresentation.recovery: four preplaced guards released once with protected resources, persisting after save/load

economicAnalysis.classification: feasibility envelope, not a combat simulation or proof of balance
economicAnalysis.walkingAndIdleIncluded: Assumed rate discounts native gathering for travel/idle; measure actual efficiency in game.
economicAnalysis.sensitivity: At 50% of assumed efficiency recompute delivery window; do not spawn hidden resources. Split workers 50%food/25%wood/20%gold/5%stone, change allocation when a specified delivery requires stone.
economicAnalysis.travelTime: Measure nav-path length in tiles / actual convoy speed plus loading/unloading; two round trips must fit between phase waves. If not, adjust announced gap or move receiving point within same documented district; architect approval for footprint drift.

personalNarration.en: My uncle brought back a chipped cup and three versions of a single afternoon. I kept the cup; I learned to name the versions.
personalNarration.es-ES: Mi tío volvió con un cuenco roto y tres versiones de una misma tarde. Guardé el cuenco; aprendí a nombrar las versiones.

scenarios.historicalOutcome: Dina no es testigo adulto de batalla; las versiones se atribuyen. No efecto mágico de manuscritos religiosos.
scenarios.choice: Escoger ruta principal o alternativa: el hecho histórico y objetivos principales permanecen.
scenarios.recovery: No atacar ambos campamentos para curar aliados. Un convoy de reserva limitado; tregua local necesita soporte acreditado; rutas a puntos distintos sin negar agua a civiles.

player.carriers: one noncombat carrier per task entity, all named fictional

tacticalRoster.proxyCautions: These are engine proxies. No generic religious race, no monks representing forced belief. Enemy units are military/raider gameplay groups, not every neighbouring civilian.

entityRepresentation.record: named noncombat carrier with physical copy object/token, no magical relic bonus
entityRepresentation.wagon: Trade Cart visual proxy with trading disabled; fixed consignments and no renewable trade gold
entityRepresentation.family: named villager groups, no farming/economic AI when representing escorted parties
entityRepresentation.military-post: Watch Tower base DE proxy; two objectives have stable unit IDs, unrelated civilians excluded
entityRepresentation.water: named noncombat consignment, amount of water is narrative inventory, not an undocumented fifth engine resource
entityRepresentation.commander: named fictional Militia proxy, essential only when objective explicitly requires commander; no sacred unit
entityRepresentation.recovery: four preplaced guards released once with protected resources, persisting after save/load

economicAnalysis.classification: feasibility envelope, not a combat simulation or proof of balance
economicAnalysis.walkingAndIdleIncluded: Assumed rate discounts native gathering for travel/idle; measure actual efficiency in game.
economicAnalysis.sensitivity: At 50% of assumed efficiency recompute delivery window; do not spawn hidden resources. Split workers 50%food/25%wood/20%gold/5%stone, change allocation when a specified delivery requires stone.
economicAnalysis.travelTime: Measure nav-path length in tiles / actual convoy speed plus loading/unloading; two round trips must fit between phase waves. If not, adjust announced gap or move receiving point within same documented district; architect approval for footprint drift.

failureRecovery.budget: One reserve escort only, drawn from protected stock and accounted starting reserve; no infinite recruit loop.
failureRecovery.notDefeat: Historical fall, sack, defeat or death of an off-map documented figure is narrative context. Player defeat is failing this mission’s rescue/supply/tactical task.
failureRecovery.deadlockDetection: No objective progress for 6 game minutes shows the exact outstanding goal and route, with optional recovery reminder. No automatic victory.

qa.expected: All narrator facts link to claim/source; uncertainty spoken when essential; fictional dialogue labelled.
Landmark banks and coast orientation match regional controls; no anachronisms listed in profile.
Flood fill with unit footprint, bridge/naval checks; land routes cannot jump water; largest convoy reaches all goals.
Targets destroyed/archives saved before activation latch and unlock later objectives.
Save before/after every delivery and wave; reload cannot duplicate or lose counts.
Roster initial plus three waves <= cap in each difficulty; all enemy production off.
Lose one courier/boat or two families; documented fallback exists without repeating payments.
Normal success rates 60–80% familiar AoE2 cohort, easy 80–95% learning cohort, hard 35–60% expert blind cohort: hypotheses, not measurements.
General factual brief then campaign person; no omniscience or lived memory before birth.
All screens EN and es-ES, 17 full destination catalogs reviewed for release; no implicit engine fallback.
Recorded 20min crowded replay below frame/simulation degradation budget.
Fresh/profile one-route/both/unknown/replay preserve cumulative keys and nonblocking static recommendation.

player.carriers: one noncombat carrier per task entity, all named fictional

tacticalRoster.proxyCautions: These are engine proxies. No generic religious race, no monks representing forced belief. Enemy units are military/raider gameplay groups, not every neighbouring civilian.

entityRepresentation.record: named noncombat carrier with physical copy object/token, no magical relic bonus
entityRepresentation.wagon: Trade Cart visual proxy with trading disabled; fixed consignments and no renewable trade gold
entityRepresentation.family: named villager groups, no farming/economic AI when representing escorted parties
entityRepresentation.military-post: Watch Tower base DE proxy; two objectives have stable unit IDs, unrelated civilians excluded
entityRepresentation.water: named noncombat consignment, amount of water is narrative inventory, not an undocumented fifth engine resource
entityRepresentation.commander: named fictional Militia proxy, essential only when objective explicitly requires commander; no sacred unit
entityRepresentation.recovery: four preplaced guards released once with protected resources, persisting after save/load

economicAnalysis.classification: feasibility envelope, not a combat simulation or proof of balance
economicAnalysis.walkingAndIdleIncluded: Assumed rate discounts native gathering for travel/idle; measure actual efficiency in game.
economicAnalysis.sensitivity: At 50% of assumed efficiency recompute delivery window; do not spawn hidden resources. Split workers 50%food/25%wood/20%gold/5%stone, change allocation when a specified delivery requires stone.
economicAnalysis.travelTime: Measure nav-path length in tiles / actual convoy speed plus loading/unloading; two round trips must fit between phase waves. If not, adjust announced gap or move receiving point within same documented district; architect approval for footprint drift.

scenarios.historicalFrame: Husayn muere en Karbala; números/discursos y motivos detallados varían según transmisión. Misión acompaña viajeros ficticios fuera del campamento histórico, no recrea el martirio como espectáculo.

personalNarration.en: I was old enough now to know a road could close. I filled the jars before asking which story would be told about the men beyond it.
personalNarration.es-ES: Ahora tenía edad para saber que un camino podía cerrarse. Llené las vasijas antes de preguntar qué historia se contaría de los hombres que quedaban al otro lado.

scenarios.historicalOutcome: Narrador común expone la muerte documentada sobriamente; Dina cierra su experiencia ficticia sin atribuirse diálogos de Husayn. Memoria posterior se contextualiza.
scenarios.choice: Salvar más familias o recuperar segundo testimonio como bonus: ninguno cambia 680 ni desbloquea una religión. Recomendar I02 para perspectiva política paralela.
scenarios.recovery: Personajes venerados fuera de mapa/no derrotables; convoy de familias ficticias. Dos pozos/rutas con presupuesto visible y un último relevo limitado; sin final histórico alternativo.

qa.expected: All narrator facts link to claim/source; uncertainty spoken when essential; fictional dialogue labelled.
Landmark banks and coast orientation match regional controls; no anachronisms listed in profile.
Flood fill with unit footprint, bridge/naval checks; land routes cannot jump water; largest convoy reaches all goals.
Targets destroyed/archives saved before activation latch and unlock later objectives.
Save before/after every delivery and wave; reload cannot duplicate or lose counts.
Roster initial plus three waves <= cap in each difficulty; all enemy production off.
Lose one courier/boat or two families; documented fallback exists without repeating payments.
Normal success rates 60–80% familiar AoE2 cohort, easy 80–95% learning cohort, hard 35–60% expert blind cohort: hypotheses, not measurements.
General factual brief then campaign person; no omniscience or lived memory before birth.
All screens EN and es-ES, 17 full destination catalogs reviewed for release; no implicit engine fallback.
Recorded 20min crowded replay below frame/simulation degradation budget.
Fresh/profile one-route/both/unknown/replay preserve cumulative keys and nonblocking static recommendation.

player.carriers: one noncombat carrier per task entity, all named fictional

tacticalRoster.proxyCautions: These are engine proxies. No generic religious race, no monks representing forced belief. Enemy units are military/raider gameplay groups, not every neighbouring civilian.

entityRepresentation.record: named noncombat carrier with physical copy object/token, no magical relic bonus
entityRepresentation.wagon: Trade Cart visual proxy with trading disabled; fixed consignments and no renewable trade gold
entityRepresentation.family: named villager groups, no farming/economic AI when representing escorted parties
entityRepresentation.military-post: Watch Tower base DE proxy; two objectives have stable unit IDs, unrelated civilians excluded
entityRepresentation.water: named noncombat consignment, amount of water is narrative inventory, not an undocumented fifth engine resource
entityRepresentation.commander: named fictional Militia proxy, essential only when objective explicitly requires commander; no sacred unit
entityRepresentation.recovery: four preplaced guards released once with protected resources, persisting after save/load

economicAnalysis.classification: feasibility envelope, not a combat simulation or proof of balance
economicAnalysis.walkingAndIdleIncluded: Assumed rate discounts native gathering for travel/idle; measure actual efficiency in game.
economicAnalysis.sensitivity: At 50% of assumed efficiency recompute delivery window; do not spawn hidden resources. Split workers 50%food/25%wood/20%gold/5%stone, change allocation when a specified delivery requires stone.
economicAnalysis.travelTime: Measure nav-path length in tiles / actual convoy speed plus loading/unloading; two round trips must fit between phase waves. If not, adjust announced gap or move receiving point within same documented district; architect approval for footprint drift.

campaigns.chronologyPolicy: Recommended order is narrative, not always chronological: the successor may overlap or revisit earlier events; announce its own date.

representation.rationale: Engine proxy for available period-neutral gameplay, never identity of a religion or claim of authentic material culture. Resolve numeric IDs from the pinned parser catalogue.
representation.dlc: Base DE proxies only; do not require Romans/RoR/DLC or silently use a different game mode.
representation.technology: Feudal maximum by default; no gunpowder, modern fortifications, monks converting faith, unique units, trebuchets or late plate-armoured knights. Battering ram is an explicit visual/technology proxy where military outposts must fall.

artDirection.medium: Painted historical illustration, map first; contemporary reference photos are for research only.
artDirection.cover: The River Remembers: Kufa and Euphrates margin, 656 CE; foreground Alfarera y proveedora de vasijas para familias viajeras; no modern skyline or invented sacred portrait.
artDirection.portrait: Fictional Dina of the Riverbank, occupational props, plain clothing without fabricated uniform; expression follows temperament. Label composite fictional narrator in credits.
artDirection.delivery: One cover, one narrator portrait, one context map per scenario; licensed or original PNG; no paid batch authorized.

text.en: The River Remembers

text.en: 656–680 CE. Follow Dina of the Riverbank through 4 scenarios. Each begins with a factual account, then a personal recollection. All campaigns can be played independently.
text.es-ES: 656–680 CE. Sigue a Dina of the Riverbank en 4 escenarios. Cada uno comienza con un relato de los hechos y después una memoria personal. Todas las campañas se pueden jugar de forma independiente.

text.en: The shared narrator gives the historical frame. The campaign narrator is a fictional person whose memories, songs and inherited accounts offer a situated perspective. Invented dialogue is never a historical quotation.

text.en: A jar remembers the hand that shaped it. A family remembers more, and not always in the same way. I will tell you which memories are mine.
text.es-ES: Una vasija conserva la mano que le dio forma. Una familia guarda más, y no siempre de la misma manera. Te diré qué recuerdos son míos.
